oneLine: Qualcomm sells Shadowfax shares worth Rs 157 crore in bulk deal

sources.title: Qualcomm Sells Shadowfax Shares Worth ₹157 Cr In Bulk Deal
Qualcomm exits Shadowfax with Rs 157 Cr stake sale

synopsis: Early backer Qualcomm Ventures, via its affiliate Qualcomm Asia Pacific Pte Limited, has sold 5.71 million shares of listed logistics company Shadowfax via an open-market bulk deal for Rs 157.3 crore. The shares were sold at Rs 275.3 apiece, representing a 6.6% discount against the stock's last closing price. The transaction comes amid a sharp uptick in Shadowfax stock prices following strong financial performance, which included a consolidated net profit surge to Rs 65.4 crore in Q1 FY27. Private equity giant TPG also recently offloaded Shadowfax shares across multiple bulk deals. Shadowfax was founded in 2015 by Abhishek Bansal and Vaibhav Khandelwal.
